newsitem.title: CANADA: Eagle Precision sets warrant issue.
newsitem.headline: Eagle Precision sets warrant issue.

text.p: Eagle Precision Technologies Inc said on Thursday underwriters have agreed to purchase for resale 897,000 special warrants and 103,000 additional special warrants of Eagle Precision at a price of C$14.25 each for total proceeds of C$14.25 million.

Eagle Precision said each special warrant will entitle the holder to acquire for no additional consideration one common share of Eagle Precision, to be qualified by a final prospectus to be filed by November 6.
Closing of the issue is slated for August 6.
